market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month around $95-96 on Apr 27 with Friday close $94.40; April low so far has not been disclosed but current bias is upward on Iran tensions. To hit $90 LOW requires ~6% drop in remaining 3 trading days. Base rate moderate; possible if Iran de-escalation deal materializes. Market priced 0.355 may overstate odds given geopolitics still elevated.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether April lows already touched $90 earlier in month not confirmed; Iran de-escalation timing
